title: Jeff Bezos’ Earth Fund adds $25 million for Pacific ocean conservation
content: The Bezos Earth Fund is allocating more than $25 million for ocean conservation projects in five Pacific nations. This funding will support various efforts: enhancing ocean management, establishing marine protected areas, and improving monitoring. The initiative aims to protect a significant portion of the ocean while promoting local leadership and community involvement. Additionally, international waters will also benefit from proposed marine protected areas.

title: IIT Bombay suicide case: Sahil Wakode's father detained on way to campus

The investigation into Sahil's death involves CCTV footage and allegations of caste-based harassment against Professor Suryanarayan Doolla. IIT-Bombay has formed a committee to examine the surrounding circumstances of his suicide.

title: From rented room to Padma Shri: How Anand Kumar built Super 30 for IIT aspirants
content: Anand Kumar launched the Ramanujan School of Mathematics in 1992 with the vision of providing quality education for talented individuals, especially those from marginalized communities. Drawing from his own economic hardships, he initiated the Super 30 program to support deserving students in their quest for higher education without financial constraints. His commitment to educational equity earned him the Padma Shri award in 2023, showcasing his impact on disadvantaged learners.

title: 'Take my wife's name': Twist in UP businessman murder as son emerges as mastermind
content: Subrat, the son of drug trader Vineet Minocha, was arrested following his alleged involvement in his father's murder. Investigators based their actions on the statement of Vishal Gautam, who claimed Subrat offered him money for the crime. Shalu, Subrat's wife, was implicated as well, with evidence suggesting she aided the murderers. Police discovered a blood-stained cloth linked to the incident during their investigation in Ratan Orbit.

title: How China helped arm Iran before Trump rolled out the red carpet for Xi
content: China's role as a self-proclaimed peace mediator is put into question with its increasing military backing for Iran. Recent findings indicate a sharp rise in military component deliveries from China, along with a surge in cargo flights by Chinese airlines dedicated to supporting Iranian defense. This partnership adds layers of complexity to U.S.-China diplomatic exchanges in the context of escalating tensions.

title: California shoppers say skincare stores pressured them into spending thousands

title: DoorDash agrees to $131.5m after payment errors affected 200,000-plus NYC workers

The settlement will directly benefit over 260,000 Dashers, addressing both missing and late payments. An additional dispute over calculation methods for on-call pay times has also been resolved in this agreement. DoorDash has acknowledged the issues caused by technical errors and improved its payment processes.

title: Why children may hide being left out by friends from their parents
content: Navigating the complexities of childhood emotions can be challenging, especially when it comes to feelings of exclusion from friends. Children may hesitate to express these feelings due to concerns over judgment or unwanted interference from parents. By cultivating an atmosphere of empathy, parents can enhance open communication. Recognizing the signs of isolation is vital for supporting a child's mental health and fostering meaningful conversations about friendships and social experiences.

title: 'Die then, we won’t stop': Driver of bus that caught fire ignored passengers' pleas to stop
content: A bus traveling from Delhi to Mahoba caught fire on the Yamuna Expressway, resulting in nine passenger fatalities. Passengers reported smelling smoke and urged the driver to stop, but the crew refused to cooperate. Flames eventually erupted, causing passengers to panic and resulting in many being trapped inside. Eight passengers suffered severe burns and had to be taken to the local hospital for treatment.

She underscores the importance of gradual progression in a world often dominated by social media comparisons. Hayek reminds creatives that delayed opportunities do not lessen their eventual triumphs, urging everyone to embrace their unique timelines for personal and professional growth.

Isaacman highlighted the critical need to expand technological frontiers to boost aircraft performance, with future advancements potentially transforming survivability in hostile airspaces.

title: Watch: Plane’s rear wheel comes off during landing at Nepal airport

The rear right wheel was lost during landing, but the pilot acted swiftly by shutting down the engine, ensuring everyone's safety. Flight operations have been halted, leading a Nepali Army aircraft to divert. Efforts are underway to clear the runway for resuming normalcy.

title: Soorya Krishnamoorthy passes away at 78

Renowned for his contributions to the performing arts after leaving his career as a scientist at ISRO in 1999, he established the Soorya Stage and Film Society. His influence on Kerala's cultural landscape through numerous productions is undeniable. Family and friends can pay their respects before his cremation this evening.

The email cautioned against asking about admission categories and academic scores, which could lead to caste discrimination. Following Wakode’s death, his family alleged castist remarks and discrimination that affected him. Investigators are examining the context surrounding his suicide, including footage from his last examination.

The judge stated that the ban likely violates constitutional rights, emphasizing the need for due process. President Trump had imposed the ban citing the outlets' accusations of reporting fake news. Following this decision, affected outlets initiated legal action against the administration to protect press freedoms.

title: Student suicide case: Rahul Gandhi speaks to IIT-B student’s parents, assures help

title: Inside China’s nuclear buildup: New activity spotted across 7 sites

Notable developments have been observed in Pingtong, Zitong, and especially Lop Nur. The Federation of American Scientists reports an estimated 620 nuclear warheads, hinting at potential future production to support new delivery systems. Despite these advancements, Chinese officials emphasize their commitment to a defensive nuclear posture and a no-first-use policy.

title: 80s kids loved power cuts: When blackouts meant terrace games and ghost stories
content: In the 1980s, power cuts often led to evenings filled with children's games and storytelling. Families gathered around candles, creating bonds and sharing experiences during blackouts. Without television or homework, children had the chance to invent their own entertainment and connect with one another. This break from electricity fostered a slower pace of life and increased family interaction.
